user.title: Connect KitaPlus
user.description: Sign in with your KitaPlus parent account (eltern.kitaplus.de). Passkeys do not work here, your account password is required. Each submit is exactly one sign-in attempt at KitaPlus. Setup stops after {max} failed attempts so your account does not get locked.

data_description.email: The email address of your KitaPlus parent account (the one you use at eltern.kitaplus.de). It is sent exactly as you type it.
data_description.password: Your KitaPlus password. It is only used for this sign-in and is never stored.

two_factor.title: Two-factor code
two_factor.description: Enter the code KitaPlus asks for: from your authenticator app or by email, depending on your account settings.

data_description.auth_code: The code from your authenticator app or the email KitaPlus just sent you.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The sign-in for {email} has expired or was rejected. Enter your current password. Exactly one sign-in attempt is made. Too many failed attempts lock the account, only the Kita management can unlock it.

data_description.password: Your current KitaPlus password. Exactly one sign-in attempt is made.

reconfigure.title: Change KitaPlus sign-in
reconfigure.description: Sign in again or change the email address. Only the same KitaPlus account is accepted. Each submit is exactly one sign-in attempt, and setup pauses after {max} failed attempts.

data_description.email: The email address of your KitaPlus parent account. It is sent exactly as you type it.
data_description.password: Your KitaPlus password. It is only used for this sign-in and is never stored.

error.invalid_auth: KitaPlus rejected the sign-in. Message from KitaPlus: “{server_message}”. This was failed attempt {attempt} of {max}. Please check email and password in the KitaPlus app (eltern.kitaplus.de) first. Too many failed attempts lock the account, and only the Kita management can unlock it.
error.invalid_code: The code was not accepted. This was failed attempt {attempt} of {max}.
error.maintenance: KitaPlus reports maintenance. This is not a password problem and nothing was counted. Please try again later.
error.cannot_connect: KitaPlus is not reachable. This is not a password problem. Please check your internet connection and try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The sign-in was not completed.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.account_locked: Your KitaPlus account is locked. Message from KitaPlus: “{server_message}”. Home Assistant will not try again. Please contact the Kita management, only they can unlock the account.
abort.too_many_attempts: Setup was stopped after {max} failed attempts so your account does not get locked. Last message from KitaPlus: “{server_message}”. Check your credentials in the KitaPlus app, then start the setup again.
abort.cooling_down: Too many failed sign-ins for this account. To keep KitaPlus from locking it, new attempts are paused for {minutes} minutes. Please check your credentials in the KitaPlus app in the meantime.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different KitaPlus account than the one set up here. Nothing was changed.

auth_failed.title: KitaPlus: sign-in rejected
auth_failed.description: KitaPlus rejected the sign-in for {email}. Message from KitaPlus: “{server_message}”. Home Assistant stopped polling and does NOT retry on its own so your account does not get locked. Open Settings → Devices & services → KitaPlus and sign in again once.

account_locked.title: KitaPlus: account locked
account_locked.description: The KitaPlus account for {email} is locked. Message from KitaPlus: “{server_message}”. Home Assistant stopped polling. Please contact the Kita management, only they can unlock it. Afterwards sign in again under Settings → Devices & services → KitaPlus.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: How often Home Assistant asks KitaPlus, in minutes (15 to 240). A higher value is gentler on the KitaPlus servers.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks KitaPlus for new data. Shorter than 15 minutes is not allowed.

session_expired.message: No stored KitaPlus session. Please sign in again.

auth_rejected.message: KitaPlus rejected the stored session. Message from KitaPlus: {server_message}

maintenance.message: KitaPlus reports maintenance. This is not a password problem. Home Assistant will try again later.

unexpected_format.message: KitaPlus sent an unexpected response format ({error}). The service may have changed. Please share the diagnostics file in an issue.
